title: TangoSpark: Beginner Level Series
description:
Ready to take your first steps in Argentine tango?

Our Beginner series is a fun, welcoming introduction designed for absolute beginners.

The series consists of 6 weekly lessons, each an hour long. You’ll learn the foundations of connection, walking together, ochos, the tango embrace, and simple turns—all at a relaxed pace that makes learning enjoyable.

🗓 Class Schedule
Tuesdays, July 1 – August 5, 8-9 pm

Where:
Dance Complex* | 536 Massachusetts Ave., Cambridge, MA 02139

💲 Pricing
- Six-Class Package: $70 (Save up to 30%!)
Our most popular option covers the whole six class series —perfect for committing to your tango journey.
Beginner Series comes with a free entrance to our Tango social – Practica Spark ($10 value), the ideal place to practice the class material.

- Drop-in (per class): $15
Prefer to try it out first? Drop-ins are welcome!

👟 What to Bring
🕺No partner required—just bring your enthusiasm and wear something comfortable. We recommend shoes that are easy to pivot in (leather or suede soles work great!).

title: Advanced Beginner Series
description:
When:
Wednesdays, July 2 – August 6, 7-8 pm 


Where:
Mango Studio | 112 Bishop Allen Dr, Cambridge, MA 02139


Building confidence and expanding your tango vocabulary.


After the Beginner series, continue your journey with our Advanced Beginner level. With four unique rotating series (A to D), you’ll develop your technique, deepen your understanding of connection, and start exploring improvisation. You’ll also be introduced to tango-specific drills and partner dynamics. These series can be taken in any order.

description:

title: Noche de Tango Argentino
description:
Join us for a summer tango party in the picturesque seaside village of Wellfleet on Saturday, July 12th. Maestro Guillermo Merlo will be spinning the tunes.                                                                                                                We will have a beautiful venue for dancing, great quality music, delicious snacks, plenty of parking, and of course, a lot of fun.

The event takes place at Wellfleet Preservation Hall (335 Main St, Wellfleet, Cape Cod, MA). An intro class kicks off the night at 6 pm, followed by a milonga from 7 to 10 pm. The cost for the class and dance party is $20 (pay at the door or online). Entry for just the dance party is $15 (at the door).

Pay online: https://www.eventbrite.com/e/learn-to-tango-noche-de-tango-argentino-tickets-1304368985749?aff=oddtdtcreator

title: Queer Milonga
description:
Queer Milonga!
Sunday, July 20, 2025
6 PM: Pre-milonga class on milonga
7 pm to 10 pm: Milonga
Location: The Allston Abbey, 5 St Lukes Rd, Allston, MA 02134
DJ: Karen Johnson

Pre-Milonga Class + Milonga: $22-$40/ $30 suggested
Milonga: $12-$30/ $20 suggested
We operate using a sliding scale.

How it works: The suggested amount allows us to break even on operational costs. Donating a little bit extra helps folks who have access to less and pays it forward to our future events.

No one will be turned away due to lack of funds.

Things to know about our Milonga:

We’re queer! Be prepared for cabaceos from anyone, and don’t assume role preference based on presentation. All are welcome, as long as you are prepared to be part of a queer-centered event.

QTB endeavors to create a warm and joyful space that is inclusive of dancers of all experience levels and backgrounds. Introduce yourself to new faces!

Accessibility

Masking is optional but encouraged, with masks free at the door. That being said… if you see a mask, wear a mask. We ask that you wear a mask if your partner is wearing one. We hope to have air filters on in the space. If you are sick, please stay home!

title: VIDA MIA MILONGA
description:
Vida Mia Milonga is a very popular milonga in the Boston area, hosted every 4th Friday of the month by Simonida Cekovic-Vuletic, TangoAffair

Friday, Feb 28, 2025: Come dance with us at the February edition of Vida Mia Milonga! Let’s shake off the winter blues together with amazing traditional tango music from our guest DJ, David Chester. Sveta and I are excited to kick things off with a fun pre-milonga class, where we’ll share our love for tango with you. There will be yummy snacks, great vibes, and lots of warm hugs. Can’t wait to see you there!  Join us on Facebook

7:30pm – 8:30pm: “RHYTHMIC and MELODIC DANCING”, a special pre-milonga workshop with Simonida and Sveta, tba. The class is geared towards intermediate/adv. dancers, but all dancers can benefit from the material taught in the class.

8:30pm – 12:30am: Milonga, DJ David Chester, yummy refreshments and cordial atmosphere

Admission (cash at the door or Venmo in advance: TangoAffair, last 4 digits of the phone number are 1550)
$35 class + milonga; $20 milonga only, $20 class only.
Full-Time Students with ID and guests who travel long distance (more than 30 miles): $30 class + milonga / $20 class only / $15 milonga only

**Vida Mia Milonga is happening every 4th Friday of the month. Join Vida Mia Milonga FB group: https://www.facebook.com/groups/122374897796873
